observation.command:
sed -i 's|ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver$|ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver /|' /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 3
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "mapserver via apache: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1" | head -c 200
